issue.title: Go panic on aws_organizations_organization import
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
tf --version
Terraform v1.16.0
on linux_amd64
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v6.61.0
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

import {
    to = aws_organizations_organization.org
    identity = {
        id = local.env.org_id
    }
}

### Expected Behavior

No panic.

### Actual Behavior

Go panic.
